snippet.title: O.D.T. Escape Again...Or Die Trying - Remaster
snippet.description:
A Hidden Gem Returns:
O.D.T: Escape Again… Or Die Trying is a full remake of the classic O.D.T: Escape... Or Die Trying, rebuilt from the ground up with modern gameplay, restored content and entirely new systems. Every highlight is amplified, every flaw reworked. This is the definitive way to experience O.D.T.
